c1fb430ce30ace665e60.en: A pronoun takes the place of a noun, so we do not repeat it.
c1fb430ce30ace665e60.id: Kata ganti (pronoun) menggantikan noun, jadi kita tidak perlu mengulangnya.

26feee5b7104a4e2cae7.en: Use he for a boy or man, and she for a girl or woman.
26feee5b7104a4e2cae7.id: Pakai he untuk anak laki-laki atau pria, dan she untuk anak perempuan atau wanita.

c55a239b10f475aa3316.en: Use it for a thing or an animal, and they for more than one.
c55a239b10f475aa3316.id: Pakai it untuk benda atau hewan, dan they untuk lebih dari satu.

ead6d80da5567df7a4ad.en: Use I, we and they before the doing word. Use me, us and them after it.
ead6d80da5567df7a4ad.id: Pakai I, we, dan they sebelum kata kerja. Pakai me, us, dan them sesudahnya.

d242b4f91e72f7bdef86.en: Put the other person first: Ali and I.
d242b4f91e72f7bdef86.id: Sebut orang lain lebih dulu: Ali and I.

b892cdfc92ad26b845ca.en: Grandma is a woman, so we use she.
b892cdfc92ad26b845ca.id: Grandma adalah perempuan, jadi kita memakai she.

df0256c2f407a38148d5.en: Mia is a girl, so we use she: She likes to draw.
df0256c2f407a38148d5.id: Mia adalah anak perempuan, jadi kita memakai she: She likes to draw.

3e8602d6586260c8b7dd.en: Tom and Ali are two people, so we use they.
3e8602d6586260c8b7dd.id: Tom dan Ali adalah dua orang, jadi kita memakai they.

2cc20541380873234d27.en: We can use it for an animal: It wants some fish.
2cc20541380873234d27.id: Kita bisa memakai it untuk hewan: It wants some fish.

5d3f15431a8344408dc3.en: Grandpa is he, Aunt Rosa is she, the bike is it, and Dina and Rio are they.
5d3f15431a8344408dc3.id: Grandpa menjadi he, Aunt Rosa menjadi she, the bike menjadi it, sedangkan Dina dan Rio menjadi they.

17fecd59651918c04a36.en: My friends and I includes you, so we use we: We eat it every day.
17fecd59651918c04a36.id: My friends and I sudah termasuk kamu, jadi kita memakai we: We eat it every day.

3c3f9f2f9195d300b94d.en: He, she and I mean one person. They, we and us mean more than one.
3c3f9f2f9195d300b94d.id: He, she, dan I berarti satu orang. They, we, dan us berarti lebih dari satu orang.

a2482aae40b1c248d585.en: After a doing word, we use them for more than one: I saw them at the park.
a2482aae40b1c248d585.id: Setelah kata kerja, kita memakai them untuk lebih dari satu: I saw them at the park.

d43d0d05d722fc2ec56a.en: Her shows the bag belongs to Lina: Her bag is new.
d43d0d05d722fc2ec56a.id: Her menunjukkan bahwa tas itu milik Lina: Her bag is new.

59ee00dd106e38bda5dc.en: She, it and me are pronouns. They take the place of names and things.
59ee00dd106e38bda5dc.id: She, it, dan me adalah kata ganti (pronoun). Kata-kata itu menggantikan nama orang dan benda.

da5e7b6d02b71fc3f84d.en: Dad is a man, so we use he: He is making soup.
da5e7b6d02b71fc3f84d.id: Dad adalah laki-laki, jadi kita memakai he: He is making soup.

7832613ef50027b6d599.en: We say I went, and we put the other person first: Ali and I went to the shop.
7832613ef50027b6d599.id: Kita bilang I went, dan orang lain kita sebut lebih dulu: Ali and I went to the shop.

5b47c649662bd8b272a9.en: They means Pak Budi and his dog. They walk to the river, and then they sit down.
5b47c649662bd8b272a9.id: They berarti Pak Budi dan anjingnya. Mereka berjalan ke sungai, lalu mereka duduk.

5bd3651f82140c704b54.en: The speaker needs help, so the pronoun is me: Can you help me?
5bd3651f82140c704b54.id: Orang yang berbicara perlu bantuan, jadi kata gantinya me: Can you help me?

5f57328473fede6325a0.en: Her, she and it replace Dewi and the hat, so the sentence does not repeat words.
5f57328473fede6325a0.id: Her, she, dan it menggantikan Dewi dan the hat, jadi kalimatnya tidak mengulang kata.

50bc60a832bf8533ec82.en: We, him, he, it and them are pronouns. That makes 5.
50bc60a832bf8533ec82.id: We, him, he, it, dan them adalah kata ganti (pronoun). Jumlahnya 5.

282b5ef9d594c12f3f37.en: The goldfish is it, and our class is we: It is orange. We feed it every morning.
282b5ef9d594c12f3f37.id: The goldfish menjadi it, dan our class menjadi we: It is orange. We feed it every morning.

093eacc05f0b27129cd2.en: They is a pronoun. It can take the place of names.
093eacc05f0b27129cd2.id: They adalah kata ganti (pronoun). Kata ini bisa menggantikan nama.

912b872999054d32e69f.en: We love our school. We is a pronoun, and our shows whose school it is.
912b872999054d32e69f.id: We love our school. We adalah kata ganti (pronoun), dan our menunjukkan sekolah siapa itu.

94fb1e92c446fe26572c.en: Ana is a girl, so we use the pronoun she.
94fb1e92c446fe26572c.id: Ana adalah anak perempuan, jadi kita memakai kata ganti she.

45cf5933606050f5bf02.en: He takes the place of Sam.

e537480cda6d7ab3f697.en: They takes the place of the girls.

23bf17991da816254e21.en: It takes the place of the bag.

3bda77a3a5b7741f887e.en: Her shows the book belongs to Dina.
3bda77a3a5b7741f887e.id: Her menunjukkan bahwa buku itu milik Dina.

b31dc78caf0c534e3894.en: They takes the place of the dogs.

7066eee90b78079a6c33.en: He, she and it are one. They, we and them are more than one.
7066eee90b78079a6c33.id: He, she, dan it berarti satu. They, we, dan them berarti lebih dari satu.

31cdce79623a86d2360a.en: Each pronoun takes the place of the noun.
31cdce79623a86d2360a.id: Setiap kata ganti (pronoun) menggantikan kata bendanya (noun).

6ef745fbd61424ba63ff.en: Sita and I went to the shop.
6ef745fbd61424ba63ff.id: Sita and I went to the shop.

5d6e5f1c015140a9f56b.id: She dan they adalah kata ganti (pronoun).

aeb81e897529190ec165.en: Its shows the paws belong to the cat.
aeb81e897529190ec165.id: Its menunjukkan bahwa paws (kaki) itu milik the cat.

eeca38aa91ab61227dad.en: A pronoun takes the place of a noun. Example: Mia likes cake. She likes cake.
eeca38aa91ab61227dad.id: Kata ganti (pronoun) menggantikan kata benda (noun). Contoh: Mia likes cake. She likes cake.

9b03d0e5b13abdc5f47b.en: He is used for a boy or a man. We use she for a girl or woman.
9b03d0e5b13abdc5f47b.id: He dipakai untuk anak laki-laki atau pria. Kita memakai she untuk anak perempuan atau wanita.

ddc3bcfb525d9c711cb4.en: We takes the place of the speaker and other people. Example: We went to the park.
ddc3bcfb525d9c711cb4.id: We menggantikan orang yang berbicara dan orang lain. Contoh: We went to the park.

3e27b6a12e24f7757dd8.en: They is a plural pronoun. Example: Ali and Budi are friends. They play together.
3e27b6a12e24f7757dd8.id: They adalah kata ganti (pronoun) untuk lebih dari satu. Contoh: Ali and Budi are friends. They play together.

440bd43852fdb940c0fa.en: Home tells us where Tom ran, so it is not a pronoun. A pronoun like he would take the place of Tom.
440bd43852fdb940c0fa.id: Home menunjukkan ke mana Tom berlari, jadi home bukan kata ganti (pronoun). Kata ganti seperti he akan menggantikan Tom.

f24b079d34af1705c3d6.en: It is used for things and animals, such as a book or a cat. Example: I like my book. It is funny.
f24b079d34af1705c3d6.id: It dipakai untuk benda dan hewan, seperti a book atau a cat. Contoh: I like my book. It is funny.

ea422a118ebbaf2b1011.en: Tom is a boy, so we use He.
ea422a118ebbaf2b1011.id: Tom adalah anak laki-laki, jadi kita memakai He.
